Definition: Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Aroer = "ruins"; 1) a city on the north bank of the river Arnon, the southern point of the territory of Sihon the king of the Amorites and later of Reuben; modern 'Arair'; 2) a city in Ammon near the Jabbok belonging to Gad; 3) a town in southern Judah
